For the assignment, login to Crunchomics via [https://omics-app01.science.uva.nl/](https://omics-app01.science.uva.nl/).

Then, prepare a directory:

```bash
# this should be your /home/UVANETID:
pwd 

# move into the MDA directory 
cd MDA

# create new directory
mkdir rna-seq-assignment 
cd rna-seq-assignment
```

Then, you copy the required materials from the shared location to your current working directory:

```bash
cp /zfs/omics/projects/education/MDA/rna-seq-assignment/* .
```

Then open the `.qmd` file and follow the instructions. Have fun!
